One localization row — four device galleries

Teams assume one zh-Hans paste covers every screenshot Apple shows. Connect actually stores per-device-class media under the same Chinese (Simplified) localization dropdown:

iPhone

6.7-inch, 6.5-inch, and legacy phone sizes — the gallery most indie teams localize first. Overlay captions and optional App Preview text for phone-sized captures. See iPhone screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for phone-only scope.

iPad

12.9-inch / 13-inch and 11-inch slots — separate uploads from iPhone frames. Universal apps often reuse phone captures stretched or reframed; overlay text must still be zh-Hans on each iPad frame. Buyers browsing on iPad hardware never see the iPhone set as their primary gallery.

Mac

Mac App Store screenshots for apps distributed on macOS — including Mac Catalyst and many "Designed for iPad" titles. Desktop aspect ratios and window chrome differ from phone art; caption lines written for a 6.7-inch workflow rarely fit a Mac frame without rephrasing.

Apple Watch

Watch app listings carry their own screenshot matrix — small square frames with tight character budgets. A localized iPhone row does not propagate Watch overlay text. Watch buyers on the China storefront see only what you uploaded for Watch.

Why device-specific English hurts on the China storefront

Apple's product page is adaptive: the storefront serves screenshots sized for the hardware viewing the page. That behavior matters for China launches where iPad and Mac browsing share is higher than many US/EU teams expect.

  • iPad buyer sees iPad set — English overlays on a zh-Hans title signal an incomplete localization pass, not a bilingual product
  • Mac buyer sees Mac set — desktop screenshots with Latin slogans under a Chinese subtitle break trust for professional or productivity apps
  • Watch buyer sees Watch set — tiny frames with English micro-copy are hard to read and easy to skip
  • App Preview mismatch — zh-Hans phone preview script autoplaying while iPad or Mac preview text is still English when buyers switch device tabs in Connect's preview tools
  • Search is not the whole story — title, subtitle, and keywords index for Search; overlay captions on each device gallery affect product-page clarity when the user already landed

Better zh-Hans captions on every device class reduce bounce on hardware-specific traffic — they do not replace in-app UI localization, screenshot re-export, or Apple review decisions.

Common mistakes on multi-device zh-Hans galleries

  • Only localizing the iPhone 6.7-inch set — iPad and Mac slots still show the en-US overlay lines Connect copied from your primary locale
  • Reusing iPhone captions verbatim on iPad frames — phone-width phrasing overflows or wraps awkwardly on 13-inch art
  • English Mac screenshots with a Chinese description — desktop buyers assume the app UI is also English-only inside
  • Watch screenshots left at default English — companion apps promoted from the iPhone listing still expose an English Watch gallery when users drill into Watch-specific pages
  • Machine-translated one-liner pasted into every device class — same 翻译腔 on Mac and Watch without adjusting for aspect ratio or feature emphasis
  • Assuming universal binary = universal metadata — binary language packs do not auto-fill Connect overlay fields per device
  • Untranslated text burned into PNG exports — Connect caption fields are Chinese but the image file still embeds English headlines (a design fix, not a metadata paste)

What good zh-Hans multi-device captions look like

Each device class gets caption lines that name what that buyer sees on that hardware — not a copy-paste of iPhone slogans:

  • iPad — emphasize split view, pencil, or large-canvas workflows visible in iPad captures; shorter lines than Mac, longer than Watch
  • Mac — name menu-bar, keyboard shortcut, or multi-window workflows; avoid phone-centric verbs like "tap" when the capture shows click targets
  • Apple Watch — one outcome per square frame; ultra-short clauses that fit Watch aspect ratios
  • Voice match — same 你/您 and punctuation habits as your zh-Hans description across device sets
  • App Preview per device — when you upload separate previews for iPad or Mac, preview title and description should describe the workflow shown in that clip — see App Preview video captions in Simplified Chinese

zh-Hans overlay lines can differ idiomatically from en-US captions on each device when the on-screen feature is the same — avoid mirroring comma-heavy English brochure lines onto iPad or Mac art.

Connect checklist before you order caption copy

  1. Open App Store → Chinese (Simplified) — confirm the zh-Hans row exists and listing text fields are saved, not placeholder English
  2. Switch device tabs in Media Manager — iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch each have their own screenshot slots; note which sets are still English
  3. Export current overlay lines — spreadsheet of English caption text per frame per device class beats screenshots of Connect alone
  4. Count frames per device — iPad 13-inch vs 11-inch may differ; Mac and Watch have their own minimum upload rules
  5. Audit App Preview text per device — preview title and description fields are separate from still-frame overlays when you use video
  6. Plan re-export if text is burned in — Connect caption fields help only when overlays are editable text layers or Connect-native captions, not English baked into PNGs
  7. Verify China in availability — Pricing and Availability includes China if the storefront should show zh-Hans media

FAQ

Does localizing iPhone screenshots also localize iPad, Mac, and Watch galleries?

No. App Store Connect stores separate screenshot and App Preview sets per device class on the same zh-Hans localization row. Completing the iPhone 6.7-inch gallery does not auto-fill iPad 13-inch, Mac, or Apple Watch screenshot slots.

Why does my China listing look English on iPad even when iPhone copy is Chinese?

The App Store product page on the China storefront shows screenshots sized for the device the buyer is using. If iPad, Mac, or Watch sets still carry English overlay lines, the page reads English-only on that hardware even when searchable listing fields are zh-Hans.

What do I send after AppLocale payment?

Your live App Store listing URL, current English overlay lines per device class (iPad / Mac / Watch), frame counts, any App Preview text tied to those devices, and target locale (zh-Hans). Reply from the email address on your Stripe receipt — we deliver to that Stripe email within 24 hours.

Can you redesign my iPad or Mac screenshot images?

No. We rewrite Connect caption fields and deliver line sheets for your workflow. Image composition and export are outside AppLocale scope.

Will localized iPad captions improve Search ranking in China?

We do not guarantee keyword position or download growth. Apple indexes title, subtitle, keywords, and description for Search — not overlay caption text. Complete zh-Hans device galleries help buyers who already landed on your product page understand the app on their hardware.
